provenance_notes: V1 curated requirements are preserved as an independent trusted source for the original 20 careers.
ESCO essential evidence is occupational evidence and is not automatically readiness-critical.
O*NET parent-occupation software evidence is treated as occupational baseline unless independently corroborated.
Domain-map support is positive corroboration and is not independent proof of a career-specific requirement.
Occupational functional evidence is not automatically treated as a directly user-matchable skill.
Supporting and context evidence do not contribute directly to readiness percentage.
Safe-shell careers contain no fabricated requirements.

attribution.esco: This service uses the ESCO classification of the European Commission.
attribution.onet: Career evidence may include adapted occupational information derived from O*NET data.
